assertions.name: N_proton_near_integer_12
assertions.source: N_proton solving the identity should be near integer 12 (0.24 ppm match).

assertions.name: N_neutron_NOT_clean_integer
assertions.source: N_neutron should NOT be close to any integer (off by ~0.47), confirming the identity is proton-specific.

description: Tests whether the proton mass substrate identity m_p = 2·m_μ·F_Bor − 12·m_e generalises to the neutron and ⁴He. Result: the identity is specific to β_Bor + H_3.  For the neutron, N_neutron ≈ 9.469 is NOT a clean integer; the neutron derivation uses m_p + canonical Δm_pn (Hecke-skein flavor-split) instead.  ⁴He uses H_12 / different braid, so the identity's ingredients (|tr_M(β_Bor)|, [3]_q!, q^3) don't directly apply.  The identity is one element of a categorical chain, not a universal mass formula.
